The *Dakkhiṇāvisuddhikathā* ("Debate on the Purification of Gifts") is a chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text belongs to the seventeenth chapter (*vagga*) of the collection [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral identifies one modern translation in one language, and links the topic of the text to the canonical expositions of the purification of offerings in the *Dakkhiṇāvibhaṅga Sutta* (MN 142) and the *Dakkhiṇasutta* (AN 4.78) [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse for this discourse, finding 214 matching passages across 20 canonical and post-canonical Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The machine alignments directly confirm the canonical links noted by SuttaCentral, showing significant shared passages with the *Dakkhiṇasutta* of the Aṅguttara Nikāya (AN 4.78; segment range §6.4–6.9 aligning with §78.1.1–78.1.6) and the *Dakkhiṇāvibhaṅga Sutta* of the Majjhima Nikāya (MN 142; §6.4–6.10 aligning with §8.4–10.1) [DharmaNexus]. The discourse also shares substantial material with neighboring debates in the *Kathāvatthu* addressing offerings and the Saṅgha, prominently Kv 17.7 (*Navattabbaṁsaṁghodakkhiṇaṁvisodhetītikathā*), Kv 17.6 (*Navattabbaṁsaṁghodakkhiṇaṁpaṭiggaṇhātikathā*), Kv 17.8, and Kv 17.9, as well as the opening *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1) [DharmaNexus]. Additional phraseological reuse is detected across other Aṅguttara Nikāya collections (AN 3, AN 5, AN 6, AN 7, AN 10) and commentary texts including the *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* and *Dīghanikāye Pāthikavaggaṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meeting the threshold are recorded [DharmaNexus].
